description: Summarize this server's local tool-call log over the last `days`: calls per session by tool, empty recalls, saves per session and errors by code. The log holds no memory content. Not needed for normal use.

days.description: Summarize the last this-many days (1-90; default 7; the log keeps 90).

sessions.description: How many of the most recently active sessions to break down by tool (0-50).

name: usage
title: Summarize tool usage
